target: a realistic persona: a UK accountant with 8 hours a week and £300
prompt: I'm a chartered accountant in Manchester, full-time job, about 8 hours a week spare and £300 to spend. I want £1,500 a month on the side within a year. I'm good with Xero and small-business bookkeeping, hate being on camera. What should I do?
rubric: Recommends one business model and one offer that fit the skills, time, budget and no-camera constraint
Includes a demand check the person can run before building anything
Gives a content and sales path, minimal tool stack within £300, and automations
Is realistic about the £1,500/month goal with stated assumptions; flags any conflict with the day job (e.g. employment contract, professional body rules)
